name: Product Merchandising Grid
description: Displays either a bounded category assortment or an authored collection of product tiles in a responsive grid.

region_definitions.name: Products
region_definitions.description: Add Product Tile components to curate this grid. This region is ignored when a category is selected.

attribute_definition_groups.name: Product Merchandising Grid
attribute_definition_groups.description: Displays either a bounded category assortment or an authored collection of product tiles in a responsive grid.

attribute_definitions.name: Category
attribute_definitions.description: Select a category to populate the product grid automatically. When set, the manual product-tile region is ignored.

attribute_definitions.name: Columns
attribute_definitions.description: Number of product columns at desktop widths.

attribute_definitions.name: Rows
attribute_definitions.description: Number of merchandising rows to display at desktop widths.
